title: [Shortcut Guide] Robustness improvements for index generation

proposed_comments.body: `Directory.EnumerateFiles(path, "*.yml")` can still throw (e.g., missing directory, broken/inaccessible manifest folder ACL), which will bypass the per-file try/catch and still abort index generation. Since Shortcut Guide assumes `index.yml` exists, it’s safer to create the directory and treat enumeration failures as an empty set (logging the error) so a valid (possibly empty) index is still written.

Index grouping is currently case-sensitive on `WindowFilter`, but matching in `ManifestInterpreter.IsMatch` is case-insensitive and the foreground path uses `First(...)` to pick a single matching entry. If two manifests differ only by `WindowFilter` casing (or have leading/trailing spaces), apps can end up split across multiple index entries and some apps may never be surfaced. Trimming and doing a case-insensitive merge into an existing key avoids that class of “missing shortcuts” bugs.

### Preserve the complete index when a manifest is temporarily locked

**Severity:** `medium`

A sharing violation from `File.ReadAllText` is currently caught as though the manifest were malformed, so generation reports success and replaces `index.yml` without that valid app. The new top-level handler already converts generation failures into a nonzero exit while the existing index remains untouched. Let `IOException` reach that handler, while continuing to skip YAML and validation errors, so a transient lock preserves the last complete index instead of publishing incomplete data.

```suggestion
                    when (ex is UnauthorizedAccessException or YamlException or NullReferenceException)
```

confidence.rationale: An exact production test with a valid manifest held under FileShare.None reproduced the upstream successful incomplete overwrite; the literal one-line candidate threw IOException and preserved the prior index, and the final minimized candidate compiled.
